facts.fact: UNDP says the timbuktoo MineTech Hub at NISIR in Lusaka ran an accelerator programme for ten startups selected from 350+ applications and concluded it on 24 September 2025, with five winners going into a three-month incubation.
UNDP says ground was broken on 12 December 2024 in Lusaka for the timbuktoo MineTech Hub, hosted at the National Institute for Scientific and Industrial Research, with construction beginning.
Minister Felix Mutati said the Zambian government has invested $3 million, with UNDP's $6 million, in the Minetech mining-technology centre of excellence, whose launch is upcoming.

facts.fact: The Absa Innovation Hub runs programmes for young people and SMEs, and together with the Solwezi hub has reached 1,131 participants, 766 SMEs and 365 young people; 30 young men and 30 young women were empowered in the Livingstone programme.
The Absa Innovation Hub operates in Solwezi, focused on mining and SME value chains, and in Livingstone, supporting the tourism ecosystem.
